_comment: Fragment to merge into the Firebase RTDB security rules (console-managed; there is no full rules file in the repo). storyReads is the read-dedupe ledger written ONLY by functions/api/hit.js, which authenticates with the service-account credential and therefore bypasses these rules. Clients must never read or write it — a reader could otherwise delete their own ledger entry to re-count, or scrape who has read what. See functions/api/hit.js.
